title: Warn when a lead session starts above its baseline
body:
Outcome: the context gauge prints a guard line when a session's first reading is at least 70k (expected ~47k); the 400k window otherwise hides a broken 142k start. Test proves the guard fires.
Metric re-run: bash .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/scratch/synthesis/run-all.sh (main checkout); baseline in baseline.txt beside it. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/synthesis.md
